name: Hydrocarbons, C12-20, hydrotreated paraffinic, distn. lights; Gasoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained as first runnings from the vacuum distillation of effluents from the treatment of heavy paraffins with hydrogen in the presence of a catalyst. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C12 through C20 and boiling in the range of approximately 230 °C to 350 °C (446 °F to 662 °F). It produces a finished oil having a viscosity of 2cSt at 100 °C (212 °F).]
